head: 1edfcbc0
headSubject: feat(dsl,generator,cli,manager): Wave 2.2 -- widget catalogue as data, CLI and generated page
summary: Advanced Wave 3 (Pigmentampa Google/GitHub OAuth sign-in): composed identity+tracing packs and restructured Artist as a 1:1 identity::User profile, added a new GET /api/auth/me primitive, extended the OAuth secret-env launcher/example docs to cover GitHub (previously Google-only), and built the sign-in-to-gallery landing/complete-profile pages. Along the way found and fixed two real platform bugs with regression tests: JwtBearerAuthFilter hardcoded its OAuth authorize/callback exemption to the literal 'google' path segment (any other provider, including GitHub, was rejected with missing_bearer_token before ever reaching the OAuth controller), and RuntimeApiEmitter's generated permission manifest never granted a 'user'-role actor 'capability.invoke' for a CRUD-delegated Flow (only flow.execute), so the first-ever non-admin-actor flow on this platform always 422'd with capability_auth on its own write.
nextStep: Nothing is committed yet on close-all-open-2026-09-22 (9 files: OperationalRunbookEmitter.java, RuntimeApiEmitter.java, OperationalRunbookOauthEnvContractTest.java, JwtBearerAuthFilter.java modified; RuntimeApiEmitterCrudDelegatedFlowCapabilityInvokeTest.java, CurrentUserController.java, CurrentUserControllerTest.java, application-pigmentampa.yml, JwtBearerAuthFilterOauthPathExemptionTest.java new). Commit these in logical chunks (generator OAuth+permission fixes; runtimehost auth-filter fix; new CurrentUserController) and push. Then a REAL Google/GitHub sign-in click-through by the user (their own account) is still needed -- only a synthetic-JWT session was tested here. After that, run Wave 3's 'End of wave: fast gate' step (python scripts/ai/run_digest.py -- pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/quality/run-fast-gate.ps1), push, then move to Wave 4 (the six deferred controllers) in the plan.
verified: Targeted gradle test runs only (not the full gate): OperationalRunbookOauthEnvContractTest (4), RuntimeApiEmitterCrudDelegatedFlowCapabilityInvokeTest + RuntimeApiEmitterAppDeclaredRoleFlowExecuteTest + RuntimeApiEmitterPermissionManifestTest, CurrentUserControllerTest (4, standalone), and Pigmentampa's own assembled-app test task (JwtBearerAuthFilterOauthPathExemptionTest + CurrentUserControllerTest, 8 total) -- all green. Real headless-browser (ScrapForAI/Playwright) verification: login.html renders both OAuth buttons, clicking GitHub navigates through the real redirect chain to github.com's actual login page with correct client_id/redirect_uri/app name. Direct HTTP checks confirm /api/auth/oauth/{google,github}/authorize return proper 302s (no missing_bearer_token). End-to-end synthetic-session test (JWT signed with Pigmentampa's own generated key + a manually inserted test identity::User row): /api/auth/me, the Artist-existence check, and POST /api/flows/RegisterArtist/execute all succeeded (status OK, Artist row created, ArtistRegistered event emitted). NOT run: run-fast-gate.ps1 or run-all-gates.ps1. NOT tested: a real Google/GitHub login with the user's own account.
